spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact IAMF types for all four accepted substream codecs across isTypeSupported, mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo (media-source), and canPlayType — surfacing the explainer's MSE-first scoping as observable data.

interactive.rationale: Run-all button re-executes every probe; each cell is a live read including the async decodingInfo triple.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises substreams × three probes with the src= scoping made visible; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles mediaCapabilities absence, decodingInfo rejection (error name shown), and interprets both all-false and mixed outcomes honestly in the status line.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416; page links siblings and the spec.

conformance.rationale: The suite's decodinginfo-agrees and mse-first-scoping assertions encode this page's two cross-probe invariants.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: all four rows render false / false-false-false / "" with the honest 0/4 status; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: iamf-matrix-ran assert reports the supported count per run.

design_system.rationale: Emerald/rose verdict cells on near-white rows (AA); CSS variables only; the wide table scrolls in its own container.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with caption and scoped row/column headers; status line is role=status aria-live; verdicts are text, not colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The min-width table scrolls inside .matrix-wrap while the page body stays at 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Capture the smooth/powerEfficient triple on an IAMF-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 every decodingInfo triple is false/false/false. On a build with IamfAudioDecoding, verify supported flips true and record whether smooth/powerEfficient are meaningful for the software decoder.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table semantics scope caption screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native table semantics with captions and scoped headers for comparison matrices.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The matrix is a real <table> with caption, scope=col and scope=row headers, plus an aria-live status summary.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide comparison table on narrow mobile viewport without page overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Own the horizontal scroll in a wrapper so the page body never scrolls sideways.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .matrix-wrap is overflow-x:auto; verified 0px page overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): all twelve probe cells are live reads that agree (all negative on Chromium 141, with the status line explaining why that agreement is the honest result). Console clean at both viewports.
